profile.mac_scope: One-sample eval forward real matrix/conv MACs, plus similarity/retrieval and lag aggregation MACs; complex matrix MACs converted to four real MACs. FFT, spectral elementwise products, normalization, activation, bias addition and other non-MAC operations are excluded. Not total FLOPs.

gpu_state_start.fields: temperature_C, SM_clock_MHz, memory_clock_MHz, power_W, GPU_utilization_percent, total_memory_used_MiB

gpu_state_end.fields: temperature_C, SM_clock_MHz, memory_clock_MHz, power_W, GPU_utilization_percent, total_memory_used_MiB

timing_scope: Full train epoch including common long-context data loading, required CPU-to-GPU transfers, decoder input construction, forward, MSE, backward and Adam. Excludes initialization, MAC profiling, validation, checkpoints and nvidia-smi audit calls.
memory_scope: PyTorch process peak allocated during measured training epochs; includes model, optimizer, inputs and activations; excludes CUDA context, allocator reserve and desktop/other processes.
